description: Root scope of cuCascade containing public API headers, runtime implementations for memory, execution, and data I/O pipelines, as well as performance benchmark suites and automation scripts.

components.name: Public C++ API Headers
components.description: Declares public interfaces, types, and configurations for data representation, I/O backends, memory spaces, and execution primitives.

components.name: Asynchronous IO Backends
components.description: Provides asynchronous multi-backend storage I/O interfaces supporting io_uring, REST/S3, kvikio, and S3-RDMA.

components.name: Tiered Memory Management
components.description: Manages multi-tier device, host, NUMA, and disk memory allocation, reservations, and pressure-driven downgrades.

components.name: Task Execution Runtime
components.description: Implements threading primitives, thread pools, semi-future continuations, and admission control for concurrent tasks.

components.name: Data Batch Management
components.description: Coordinates pipeline data batches, thread-safe repositories, and cross-tier representation transitions.

components.name: CUDA Utilities and Diagnostics
components.description: Supplies core CUDA event handling, asynchronous device memory copies, logging, and error utilities.

components.name: CUDF Tabular Integration
components.description: Bridges libcuCascade I/O and representations with libcudf datasources and columnar tables.

components.name: Core Engine Runtime Implementation
components.description: Implements data transfer pipelines, storage backends, memory reservations, and cuDF datasource integrations.

components.name: Storage and Network IO Backend
components.description: Provides pluggable asynchronous I/O contexts and data sources for local storage, REST/S3, and io_uring.

components.name: Memory Allocation and Topology
components.description: Manages device and host memory allocations, NUMA topology discovery, reservations, and out-of-memory policies.

components.name: Dataframe Representation and Source Adapters
components.description: Implements GPU and host data table representations and datasource bindings backed by cuDF.

components.name: Disk Data and Batch Management
components.description: Coordinates disk-backed data batches, disk data representations, and asynchronous pipeline I/O backends.

components.name: Thread Execution Utilities
components.description: Utilities for configuring thread names, CPU affinity, scheduling policies, and thread niceness.

components.name: Storage and Conversion Benchmarks
components.description: Measures throughput and latency for parquet reading, representation conversion, and storage I/O mechanisms.

components.name: Developer and Benchmark Utilities
components.description: Automates benchmark result regression testing and API documentation generation.
